app_fee.value: Application fee is $30 for each application submitted.
app_fee.quote: Complete a graduate application online and submit the non-refundable $30 application fee.

fee_waiver.value: Application fee waivers are available for specific qualifying graduate programs/scholars; no hardship fee waivers are provided.
fee_waiver.quote: An application fee waiver may be available for students applying to specific graduate programs. | The College of Graduate Studies does not provide hardship fee waivers.

gre_general.value: The university does not set a campus-wide GRE requirement; requirements are set individually by each degree program.
gre_general.quote: If the GRE or GMAT is required, the specific test will be explicitly stated in the “Admissions Requirements” section of the program.

toefl_min.value: Minimum university requirement is 80 on TOEFL iBT (or 4 on revised test). Certain programs require higher scores.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum UCF Requirement for TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo | TOEFL iBT | 80 | NOTE: Certain graduate programs require higher TOEFL iBT, IELTS or DET scores. Review your program’s application requirements for minimum score requirements.

ielts_min.value: Minimum university requirement is 6.5 overall band.

english_waiver.value: Exemption is granted for applicants who earned a degree from an institution where English is the only official language of instruction.
english_waiver.quote: Those who have earned a degree equivalent to a U.S. Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Doctoral degree from a university where English is the only official language of instruction. | Applicants who meet the criteria will have this requirement waived once an application fee has been received and their application has been processed.
